scope: Existing four-domain release targets, without caller hints or confirmations
discipline: V1 distinctive-context policies preceded their first run. V2 scoped-context policies were developed from V1 development failures. V3 qualified-context refinements were developed from V2 development failures and useful-match losses; they and the corresponding opt-in runtime port are declared before their own first scoring run. Earlier policies remain unchanged. No per-ID mappings, fixture concepts, labels, rationales, or gold-derived metadata reach matching. IDs address caches only. Family variants stay together. Original development remains the same primary comparison; Stage3 extension and corrective development are separate stress comparisons. The runtime strict-identifier policy is nominated before V3 scoring. No reserved or historical holdout scoring path exists in this exploration. A separately authored unexamined corpus must be evaluated after freezing implementation, protocol, configuration and executable. Existing defaults remain unchanged.
